title: Renewal, Non-Renewal Notice and Cancellation Figures of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
## Clause 1. Renewal figures

The Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs renew, escalate and end on the figures stated for the tier the owner holds.

| Tier | Program renews automatically at term end | Days before term end at which the renewal window opens (calendar days) | Days before term end by which a non-renewal notice must be received (calendar days) | Escalation applied to the program price at each renewal (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter Supply Program | Yes | 30 | 15 | 5.0 |
| Managed Filtration Program | Yes | 45 | 30 | 4.5 |
| Coil Hygiene Program | Yes | 45 | 30 | 4.5 |
| Air Quality Monitoring Program | Yes | 60 | 30 | 4.0 |
| UV & Purification Service Program | Yes | 60 | 45 | 3.5 |
| Certified Indoor Air Quality Program | No | 90 | 60 | 3.0 |

## Clause 2. Cancellation figures

| Tier | Days of written notice before a cancellation takes effect (calendar days) | Fee on the unbilled remainder of the term when the program is cancelled early (percent) | Portion of undelivered included filter sets refunded at cancellation (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Filter Supply Program | 15 | 0 | 0 |
| Managed Filtration Program | 30 | 20 | 50 |
| Coil Hygiene Program | 30 | 25 | 50 |
| Air Quality Monitoring Program | 30 | 25 | 50 |
| UV & Purification Service Program | 45 | 30 | 75 |
| Certified Indoor Air Quality Program | 60 | 40 | 100 |

## Clause 3. Reading of the figures

3.1 Automatic renewal is set at every tier other than the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program, which does not renew automatically.

3.2 The renewal window and the non-renewal notice period are both counted in calendar days before the term end; at every tier the window opens earlier than the notice deadline falls (30 against 15 at the Filter Supply Program, 45 against 30 at the Managed Filtration Program and the Coil Hygiene Program, 60 against 30 at the Air Quality Monitoring Program, 60 against 45 at the UV & Purification Service Program, 90 against 60 at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program).

3.3 The escalation is a percentage applied to the program price at each renewal, falling from 5.0 percent at the Filter Supply Program to 3.0 percent at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program.

3.4 The early cancellation fee is a percentage of the unbilled remainder of the term, and the refund portion is a percentage of the undelivered included filter sets; at the Filter Supply Program both are 0 percent, and at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program they are 40 percent and 100 percent.
